title: Asymptotic Behavior of Radial Solutions to Singular $p$-Laplacian Equations as $p\to1$
summary: We study the singular limit $p \downarrow 1$ for positive radial entire solutions $u_p$ of $$ -Δ_p u_p=F_p\left(|x|, u_p,\left|\nabla u_p\right|\right) u_p^{-β_p} \quad \text { in } \mathbb{R}^n, $$ where $n \geq 2,1<p<\min \{2, \sqrt{n}\}$, and $0 \leq β_p \leq p-1$.
